name: USPTO PatentsView
tagline: Official USPTO patent search and bulk analytics API for US patents and inventors
description: PatentsView provides programmatic access to USPTO patent data including patents, inventors, assignees, and citations. It supports structured search queries for US patent documents and related entities, enabling bulk analytics, prior-art research, and inventor/assignee lookups. The API is the developer-facing interface for PatentsView’s open patent data platform.

auth.details: API key required via X-Api-Key header; self-serve key request on PatentsView site

use_cases: search US patents by keyword or patent number
look up inventors and assignees for a patent
retrieve citation networks for prior-art analysis
